summary: Both editions were independently reviewed against every clause of the selected working Greek. No concrete fidelity defect was identified. Both preserve the necessary use of some round stones, the distinction between stones set aside and stones rejected, speaker attribution, and the selected no-joint negation. The simplified edition’s shorter constructions retain these substantive distinctions. Notes disclose the bracketed material, the certainty alternatives, and the bounded negative selection without replacing the working reading or claiming fresh manuscript verification. Acceptance concerns fidelity to the supplied source and accurate disclosure of the supplied reports, not authentication of unseen editions or exhaustive witness collation.
